goal: Produce a bounded Phase 3B prototype-grade art candidate set using a real image generation workflow, record asset manifest and risk notes, and prepare owner review handoff without mutating Godot or approving final art.
forbidden_changes: final art direction, style bible, full asset pack, production-ready asset approval, or public-release asset usage
enemy, item, scoring, camera polish, web export, double jump, wall jump, dash, or movement-verb decisions
external tester workflow, platform launch feedback, market validation, or release channel decisions
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Only authorized Phase 3B artifacts changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(art_notes/AN-2026W22-003-art-production-capability-boundary.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-018.json|runs/RUN-20260531-001.json|art_candidates/phase3b/phase3b_candidate_sheet_v1.png|art_candidates/phase3b/asset_manifest.json|art_notes/AN-2026W22-004-art-production-candidate-report.md|owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-003-phase3b-art-candidates-KR.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-019.json|runs/RUN-20260531-002.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

human_decision_reason: BK/Human Creative Owner must approve, redirect, or reject the generated prototype-grade candidate set before QA or Implementation treats it as approved input.
acceptance_criteria: The Work Package authorizes only the Phase 3B candidate asset sheet, asset manifest, candidate report, owner review handoff, its Work Package record, and its Run record.
The Art Agent uses a real image generation workflow and records prompt/tool evidence.
The manifest records each candidate role, usage scope, license or rights risk, Godot import risk, gameplay scope risk, owner review status, and implementation handoff note.
The candidate report separates capability validation from final art direction or production asset approval.
The owner review handoff is Korean and records Decision as pending.
No Godot, schema, agent profile, context, research note, QA review, Learning Card, final art direction, style bible, full asset pack, or external feedback files are changed by this slice.
notes: This Work Package executes Phase 3B Art Agent tool capability validation using one generated review sheet. The output is prototype-review-only and does not authorize Godot implementation or production use.
